body.name: \(U_n(\mathbf k)\)
body.construction: For \(\mathbf k=(m_\tau,m_e,m_b)\in\mathcal K_n\), let \(R(\mathbf k)=(m_\tau m_e m_b)^d\), \(N_1=n\), \(N_2=\max\{1,n(n-1)\}\), \(N_3=\max\{1,n(n-1)(n-2)\}\), and \(N_4=\max\{1,n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)\}\). Define the complete bias envelope \[B(\mathbf k)=2Ld^{\gamma/2}m_\tau^{-\gamma}+4L^2d^{(\alpha+\beta)/2}m_e^{-\alpha}m_b^{-\beta}+4L^2d^{(\alpha+\gamma)/2}m_e^{-\alpha}m_\tau^{-\gamma}+4L^2d^{(\beta+\gamma)/2}m_b^{-\beta}m_\tau^{-\gamma},\] and the four complete-Hoeffding stochastic terms \[S_q(\mathbf k)=\left\{\frac{2^{8q}\Lambda_n^qR(\mathbf k)^{q-1}}{N_q}\right\}^{1/2},\qquad q=1,2,3,4.\] The deterministic envelope is \[U_n(\mathbf k)=\min\left[1,\ B(\mathbf k)+\left\{S_1(\mathbf k)+S_2(\mathbf k)+S_3(\mathbf k)+S_4(\mathbf k)\right\}^{1/2}\right].\]
